candidate_policy: Preserve all 17 requested models in the catalog and full screening plan. This proposal freezes only the eight documented small complimentary-token candidates for the first execution batch. No substitutions; medium reasoning for reasoning models, no reasoning parameter for nonreasoning models. Current documented complimentary eligibility is required separately from model access.

excluded_candidates.reason: Deferred by explicit user choice to prepare OpenAI-only first. No Anthropic or Google credentials are required for this manifest.

common_protocol.semantic_input: Identical product-generated source/context, policy text and semantic output schema for every candidate. The oracle is never sent to the model.
common_protocol.transport: The existing product OpenAI SDK and NDJSON executor are reused. Only model, reasoning effort and output cap are replaced with the frozen candidate configuration; prompt, source/context and strict semantic schema remain byte-equivalent.
common_protocol.conversation: Independent single-turn requests; no hidden prior interaction or provider conversation.
common_protocol.cache: No explicit prompt-cache write requests, prewarming or discarded warmups. Report observed cache tokens and first schema use separately; provider-injected format instructions and automatic grammar caching are observable envelope differences.
common_protocol.sampling: Use the explicit supported OpenAI reasoning effort. No temperature or other sampling override.
common_protocol.service_tier: Explicit Responses service_tier=default for standard pricing; auto/project-default routing is forbidden. Record returned tier; unexpected tier stops execution and absent tier retains full cost reservation.
common_protocol.candidate_configuration: Explicit medium for reasoning models; reasoning omitted for nonreasoning models. Exact dated snapshots. Other request fields unchanged.
common_protocol.retries: Zero transport and SDK retries for screening; every attempted request remains evidence.
common_protocol.request_equivalence: Same product prompt, source snapshot, accepted context, response schema, parser and oracle; only explicit candidate model/reasoning/output/service-tier fields differ. Every raw failure is retained.

order.strategy: Interleave candidates within each case, rotate first candidate by case/repetition; every planned row is emitted even if later stopped.

observation_profile.purpose: Bounded qualification observation window, not a new product freshness SLO. Retain whether each result crossed the unchanged 6s/8s runtime reference. Values beyond the observation window remain censored, not zero-latency or semantic failures.
observation_profile.retry_policy: Zero transport and SDK retries. One provider attempt per trial; retain failures.

selection_rule: Screening only: report per-case semantic correctness and accepted complete-response latency. Retain every failure. Repeat promising currently-supported candidates on all 26 frozen cases × 3 before selecting a replacement. One repetition and six cases do not support p95 or production claims.
freeze_requirements: Reviewed exact eight-candidate small-model subset and six-case selection
Original #57 product SHA f82a97a987a71f0a4ef165827bf2870bef10dcca and clean evaluator SHA
Unchanged reviewed 26-case corpus/oracle, selected subset explicitly enumerated
Read-only exact model availability and exact payload-bound input-token counts without test-only markers
Separate manifest-bound authorization; enrolled project, fresh remaining organization allowance and other API traffic paused
No automatic daily reset, provider/model substitution, settings changes, product-model change or paid overages
paid_execution_requirements: Separate explicit approval of this exact manifest SHA-256 and limits SHA-256
All required API credentials preflight before dispatch; active unexpired manifest, clean bound code and exact request bytes
scope: First complimentary screening batch for eight documented small OpenAI models requested on 2026-09-13. One repetition is preliminary screening, not final qualification. Six matched cases preserve complete/incomplete, unit presence/absence and Stage handoff contrasts.

complimentary_policy.eligibility_caveat: o3-mini appears in the user account banner but is absent from the current Help Center offer list; free-only execution requires resolution. Other models are documented, enrollment and remaining organization allowance must still be checked.

runtime_reference_note: The 6/8-second product policy is the historical reference from the original 312-trial comparison. Screening uses the same #57 product commit and unchanged 30/35-second observation policy; zero-retry execution_profile is authoritative.
scope_limitations: Only six cases in three contrast pairs are exercised; reference binding, correction identity, explicit relations, field corrections and false-terminal recovery still require the broader 26-case comparison.
Numerical latency summaries are descriptive; do not infer a production tail or change the selected model from one screening repetition.
